title: Theo and the Clock
author: Quentin Vasquez
blurb: Elodie Sterling, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
